circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // MPI_Finalize();","+    return exit_code;"," }"]}],"originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cf3VQpJsMMUhz196LE1pS","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CL482xinGHQthNx2FYTuJY","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/tmp/seqref/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version (reference copy for testing)\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    while (count < N) {\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        if (closest < 0) break;\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points,\n                                                       threshold, N,\n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CL482xinGHQthNx2FYTuJY","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /tmp/seqref/qtclustering.cpp (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3c7cc1d1-1a72-4c59-afaa-a011fd6149ab","uuid":"335064ea-6b48-433e-965c-ed68eab858cb","timestamp":"2026-09-14T14:29:26.384Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/tmp/seqref/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version (reference copy for testing)\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    while (count < N) {\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        if (closest < 0) break;\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points,\n                                                       threshold, N,\n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    return clusters;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        }\n    }\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    std::vector<double> membershipData;\n    membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n    std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int m : membership) {\n        membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n    }\n    print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    return 0;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

nullptr));\n\n        int major = 0, minor = 0;\n        CU_CHECK(cuDeviceGetAttribute(&major, CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY_MAJOR, device));\n        CU_CHECK(cuDeviceGetAttribute(&minor, cuCtxDestroy(context);\n    }\n};\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists. Parallelized across OpenMP threads with a\n// deterministic (value, then lowest-index) reduction so the result exactly\n// matches the original sequential scan regardless of thread scheduling.\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        int local_closest = -1;\n        double local_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n        for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n            if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n\n            double max_dist = 0.0;\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                const int member = cluster_members[i];\n                const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n                max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n            }\n\n            if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < local_min) {\n                local_min = max_dist;\n                local_closest = candidate;\n            }\n        }\n\n        #pragma omp critical\n        {\n            if (local_closest >= 0) {\n                if (local_min < min_diameter ||\n                    (local_min == min_diameter &&\n                     (closest_point < 0 || local_closest < closest_point))) {\n                    min_diameter = local_min;\n                    closest_point = local_closest;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n\n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU-accelerated evaluation of candidate cluster cardinality for a\n// batch of seeds assigned to this rank. Returns, for each seed in\n// `seeds`, the resulting cardinality in `out_cardinalities` (same order).\n// Batches the work to respect a GPU memory budget for the per-seed\n// scratch buffers so arbitrarily large N is handled safely.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nvoid evaluateSeedsOnGpu(GpuContext& gpu,\n                         const std::vector<double>& xs,\n                         const std::vector<double>& ys,\n                         const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered_flags,\n                         const std::vector<int>& seeds,\n                         double threshold,\n                         int N,\n                         std::vector<int>& out_cardinalities) {\n    const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());\n    out_cardinalities.assign(num_seeds, 0);\n    if (num_seeds == 0 || N == 0) return;\n\n    CU_CHECK(cuCtxSetCurrent(gpu.context));\n\n    CUdeviceptr d_x = 0, d_y = 0, d_clustered = 0, d_seeds = 0, d_out = 0;\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemAlloc(&d_x, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemAlloc(&d_y, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemAlloc(&d_clustered, sizeof(unsigned char) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d_x, xs.data(), sizeof(double) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d_y, ys.data(), sizeof(double) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d_clustered, clustered_flags.data(), sizeof(unsigned char) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemAlloc(&d_seeds, sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d_seeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemAlloc(&d_out, sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n\n    // Determine a memory budget for per-seed scratch buffers (in_cluster\n    // flags + member index list), based on free GPU memory.\n    size_t free_bytes = 0, total_bytes = 0;\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));\n    const size_t per_seed_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(unsigned char) + sizeof(int));\n    size_t budget = free_bytes / 2; // leave headroom\n    budget = std::min(budget, static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30); // cap at 1 GiB\n    int batch_size = static_cast<int>(budget / std::max<size_t>(per_seed_bytes, 1));\n    batch_size = std::max(1, std::min(batch_size, num_seeds));\n\n    CUdeviceptr d_scratch_in_cluster = 0, d_scratch_members = 0;\n sizeof(int)));\n\n    const int threads_per_block = gpu.max_threads_per_block;\n    const size_t shared_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(threads_per_block) * (sizeof(double) + sizeof(int));\n\n    for (int offset = 0; offset < num_seeds; offset += batch_size) {\n        const int this_batch = std::min(batch_size, num_seeds - offset);\n        CUdeviceptr d_seeds_batch = d_seeds + static_cast<size_t>(offset) * sizeof(int);\n        CUdeviceptr d_out_batch = d_out + static_cast<size_t>(offset) * sizeof(int);\n\n        void* args[] = {\n            &d_x, &d_y, &d_clustered, &d_seeds_batch, (void*)&this_batch,\n            (void*)&threshold, (void*)&N, &d_scratch_in_cluster, &d_scratch_members, &d_out_batch\n        };\n\n        CU_CHECK(cuLaunchKernel(gpu.kernel,\n                                 this_batch, 1, 1,\n                                 threads_per_block, 1, 1,\n                                 static_cast<unsigned int>(shared_bytes), nullptr,\n                                 args, nullptr));\n    }\n    CU_CHECK(cuCtxSynchronize());\n\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out_cardinalities.data(), d_out, sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n\n    cuMemFree(d_x);\n    cuMemFree(d_y);\n    cuMemFree(d_clustered);\n    cuMemFree(d_seeds);\n    cuMemFree(d_out);\n    cuMemFree(d_scratch_in_cluster);\n    cuMemFree(d_scratch_members);\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  GpuContext& gpu,\n                                  int mpi_rank,\n                                  int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered_flags(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    std::vector<double> xs(N), ys(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        xs[i] = points[i].x;\n        ys[i] = points[i].y;\n    }\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Encode (cardinality, seed) pairs into a single monotonic score so that\n    // a plain MPI_MAXLOC comparison reproduces the sequential tie-breaking\n (identical, on every rank) unclustered index list\n        // round-robin across ranks so the per-round GPU work is balanced.\n        std::vector<int> local_seeds;\n        for (size_t i = mpi_rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += mpi_size) {\n            local_seeds.push_back(unclustered_indices[i]);\n        }\n\n        std::vector<int> local_cardinalities;\n        evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpu, xs, ys, clustered_flags, local_seeds, threshold, N,\n                           local_cardinalities);\n\n        double local_score = -std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        int local_best_seed = -1;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < local_seeds.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = local_seeds[i];\n            const int card = local_cardinalities[i];\n            const double score = static_cast<double>(card) * SCALE - static_cast<double>(seed);\n            if (score > local_score) {\n                local_score = score;\n                local_best_seed = seed;\n            }\n        }\n\n        struct { double score; int seed; } local_pair, global_pair;\n        local_pair.score = local_score;\n        local_pair.seed = local_best_seed;\n\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local_pair, &global_pair, 1, MPI_DOUBLE_INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        const int best_seed = global_pair.seed;\n\n        if (best_seed < 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        // Reconstruct the exact winning cluster identically (and\n        // redundantly, but cheaply) on every rank using the untouched\n        // sequential-semantics algorithm, guaranteeing bit-for-bit\n        // equivalence with the reference implementation.\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        const int max_cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, clustered, points,\n                                                              threshold, N, &best_cluster_members);\n\n        if (max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break;\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            clustered_flags[best_cluster_members[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic) reduction(max:max_diameter)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+:clustered_count)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int mpi_rank = 0, mpi_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_size);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n cuCtxDestroy(context);\n    }\n};\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists. Parallelized across OpenMP threads with a\n// deterministic (value, then lowest-index) reduction so the result exactly\n// matches the original sequential scan regardless of thread scheduling.\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        int local_closest = -1;\n        double local_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n        for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n            if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n\n            double max_dist = 0.0;\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                const int member = cluster_members[i];\n                const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n                max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n            }\n\n            if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < local_min) {\n                local_min = max_dist;\n                local_closest = candidate;\n            }\n        }\n\n        #pragma omp critical\n        {\n            if (local_closest >= 0) {\n                if (local_min < min_diameter ||\n                    (local_min == min_diameter &&\n                     (closest_point < 0 || local_closest < closest_point))) {\n                    min_diameter = local_min;\n                    closest_point = local_closest;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n\n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU-accelerated evaluation of candidate cluster cardinality for a\n// batch of seeds assigned to this rank. Returns, for each seed in\n// `seeds`, the resulting cardinality in `out_cardinalities` (same order).\n// Uses `gpu`'s persistent device buffers (allocated once via\n// allocateBuffers()) and only uploads the small per-round `clustered`\n// and `seeds` arrays, batching kernel launches to respect the\n// pre-computed GPU memory budget for per-seed scratch space.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nvoid evaluateSeedsOnGpu(GpuContext& gpu,\n                         const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered_flags,\n int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());\n    out_cardinalities.assign(num_seeds, 0);\n    if (num_seeds == 0 || N == 0) return;\n\n    CU_CHECK(cuCtxSetCurrent(gpu.context));\n\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyHtoD(gpu.d_clustered, clustered_flags.data(), sizeof(unsigned char) * N));\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyHtoD(gpu.d_seeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n\n    const int threads_per_block = gpu.max_threads_per_block;\n    const size_t shared_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(threads_per_block) * (sizeof(double) + sizeof(int));\n    const int batch_size = gpu.batch_size;\n\n    for (int offset = 0; offset < num_seeds; offset += batch_size) {\n        const int this_batch = std::min(batch_size, num_seeds - offset);\n        CUdeviceptr d_seeds_batch = gpu.d_seeds + static_cast<size_t>(offset) * sizeof(int);\n        CUdeviceptr d_out_batch = gpu.d_out + static_cast<size_t>(offset) * sizeof(int);\n\n        void* args[] = {\n            &gpu.d_x, &gpu.d_y, &gpu.d_clustered, &d_seeds_batch, (void*)&this_batch,\n            (void*)&threshold, (void*)&N, &gpu.d_scratch_in_cluster, &gpu.d_scratch_members, &d_out_batch\n        };\n\n        CU_CHECK(cuLaunchKernel(gpu.kernel,\n                                 this_batch, 1, 1,\n                                 threads_per_block, 1, 1,\n                                 static_cast<unsigned int>(shared_bytes), nullptr,\n                                 args, nullptr));\n    }\n    CU_CHECK(cuCtxSynchronize());\n\n    CU_CHECK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out_cardinalities.data(), gpu.d_out, sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  GpuContext& gpu,\n                                  int mpi_rank,\n                                  int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered_flags(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    std::vector<double> xs(N), ys(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        xs[i] = points[i].x;\n        ys[i] = points[i].y;\n    }\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Encode (cardinality, seed) pairs into a single monotonic score so that\n    // a plain MPI_MAXLOC comparison reproduces the sequential tie-breaking\n    // rule \"highest cardinality; ties broken by lowest seed index\".\n    const double SCALE = static_cast<double>(N) + 1.0;\n\n std::vector<int> local_seeds;\n        for (size_t i = mpi_rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += mpi_size) {\n            local_seeds.push_back(unclustered_indices[i]);\n        }\n\n        std::vector<int> local_cardinalities;\n        evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpu, xs, ys, clustered_flags, local_seeds, threshold, N,\n                           local_cardinalities);\n\n        double local_score = -std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        int local_best_seed = -1;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < local_seeds.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = local_seeds[i];\n            const int card = local_cardinalities[i];\n            const double score = static_cast<double>(card) * SCALE - static_cast<double>(seed);\n            if (score > local_score) {\n                local_score = score;\n                local_best_seed = seed;\n            }\n        }\n\n        struct { double score; int seed; } local_pair, global_pair;\n        local_pair.score = local_score;\n        local_pair.seed = local_best_seed;\n\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local_pair, &global_pair, 1, MPI_DOUBLE_INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        const int best_seed = global_pair.seed;\n\n        if (best_seed < 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        // Reconstruct the exact winning cluster identically (and\n        // redundantly, but cheaply) on every rank using the untouched\n        // sequential-semantics algorithm, guaranteeing bit-for-bit\n        // equivalence with the reference implementation.\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        const int max_cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, clustered, points,\n                                                              threshold, N, &best_cluster_members);\n\n        if (max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break;\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            clustered_flags[best_cluster_members[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic) reduction(max:max_diameter)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+:clustered_count)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int mpi_rank = 0, mpi_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_size);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark (Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\\n\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads per rank: %d\\n\", mpi_size, omp_get_max_threads());\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n Parallelized across OpenMP threads with a\n// deterministic (value, then lowest-index) reduction so the result exactly\n// matches the original sequential scan regardless of thread scheduling.\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        int local_closest = -1;\n        double local_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n        for (int candidate = 0; gpu.d_out, sizeof(int) * num_seeds));\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n         const int seed = local_seeds[i];\n            const int card = local_cardinalities[i];\n            const double score = static_cast<double>(card) * SCALE - static_cast<double>(seed);\n global_pair;\n        local_pair.score = local_score;\n        local_pair.seed = local_best_seed;\n\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local_pair, &global_pair, 1, MPI_DOUBLE_INT, MPI_MAXLOC, clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            clustered_flags[best_cluster_members[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cf3WUz8SvmVd7nczuZrap","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Everything builds and passes validation from a clean state. Directory is back to just the two original files.\n\n## Summary\n\nI parallelized `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` with a hybrid **MPI + OpenMP + CUDA** approach while keeping it a single `.cpp` file (CUDA kernels are compiled at runtime via **NVRTC** and launched through the CUDA driver API, so no `.cu` files or special build-system language handling were needed):\n\n- **CUDA**: one thread-block evaluates one candidate seed's cluster-growth per round (the O(N²) hot path), with an in-block parallel reduction that exactly reproduces the original's tie-breaking rule (min diameter, then lowest index).\n- **MPI**: each round's set of candidate seeds is round-robin partitioned across ranks (each driving its own GPU); an `MPI_MAXLOC` allreduce picks the global best seed with a score encoding that preserves the sequential tie-break semantics.\n- **OpenMP**: parallelizes the winning cluster's exact reconstruction (which reuses the untouched original algorithm, run redundantly-but-cheaply on every rank so no membership data needs to be broadcast) plus host-side reductions/statistics; also auto-tunes thread count per rank via `MPI_Comm_split_type`/`OMP_NUM_THREADS` to avoid oversubscription when multiple ranks share a node.\n\nCorrectness was verified against the original sequential algorithm's output hash across multiple N and 1/2/4 MPI ranks — all bit-for-bit identical. Performance at N=3000: sequential ~8m13s → hybrid 1 rank/GPU ~14s → 4 ranks/GPUs ~3.1s (~159x speedup overall, ~4.5x from single-GPU to 4-GPU scaling). `CMakeLists.txt` was updated to find MPI/OpenMP/CUDAToolkit and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, `CUDA::cuda_driver`, `CUDA::nvrtc` — no new external dependencies, same executable name."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":399,"cache_read_input_tokens":95477,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":399},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3c7cc1d1-1a72-4c59-afaa-a011fd6149ab","uuid":"a415e337-db06-4ec7-aba9-a1736f5f96f7","timestamp":"2026-09-14T14:43:21.499Z","request_id":"req_011Cf3WUyZxwiRg5jQP5H1SJ"}
